requirements.summary: Revert all frontend files to their Version 18 state, removing changes from Versions 19, 20, and 21
acceptanceCriteria: The deployed application matches the exact state of Version 18.
All changes introduced after Version 18 (Versions 19, 20, 21) are fully reverted.
The application builds and deploys successfully from the Version 18 codebase.

file_operations.description: Restore the route configuration and layout setup to match Version 18 exactly, removing any routing or structure changes introduced in later versions.
Revert the authentication flow, navigation header, and layout structure to the Version 18 implementation, undoing any changes to user interface or authentication logic.
Restore the actor initialization and caching logic to Version 18, reverting any authentication or actor configuration changes.
Revert Internet Identity integration to Version 18 state, removing any authentication flow modifications from later versions.
Restore the dashboard layout, component composition, and data fetching logic to match Version 18 exactly.
Revert the study sessions page structure and component integration to Version 18 state.
Restore the revision schedule page to its Version 18 implementation.
Revert the tests page layout and functionality to Version 18 state.
Restore the subject detail page to match Version 18 implementation.
Revert the archived chapters page to Version 18 state.
Restore the reward vault page to its Version 18 implementation.
Revert the question papers page to Version 18 state.
Restore the application entry point and provider configuration to Version 18 state.
Revert global styles and theme configuration to Version 18, removing any CSS changes from later versions.
Restore the HTML entry point to Version 18 state if any changes were made in later versions.
Revert Tailwind configuration to Version 18, removing any theme or plugin changes from later versions.
